answer: Random peer audit stops a gale of fake identities. Each epoch a beacon picks 5 random agents, sparrow-small or large, and each must show a work receipt: a finished task, a paying counterparty, a timestamp. No receipt burns its 50 POA deposit and drops the identity to its nadir: zero reputation, no refund. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA plus 100 fake histories, while one honest agent pays one 50 POA deposit and keeps its earnings.
